title: He Made $1 Billion in One Day Betting Against Britain #shorts
description:
On September 16, 1992, George Soros bet ten billion dollars against the British pound and won over one billion in a single day. The story of Black Wednesday.
Follow for more stories of fortunes made and lost.

lines.text: In one day, he made over one billion dollars betting against a country.
It was nineteen ninety-two, and George Soros saw a weakness.
Britain was holding the pound at a price the market said was too high.
So Soros and his fund bet ten billion dollars that the pound would fall.
On September sixteenth, the Bank of England fought back.
It raised interest rates from ten to twelve percent. Then to fifteen percent, in a single day.
It didn't work. Traders kept selling.
That evening, Britain gave up and pulled the pound out of the system.
The pound crashed, and Soros walked away with over one billion dollars.
The press called him the man who broke the Bank of England.
